briefTitle: A Phase 2 Study of VS-7375 in Patients With KRAS G12D-Mutated Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Histopathology confirmed unresectable locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC is in scope but does not list specific stages for a stage_in check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Measurable disease per RECIST 1.1
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients with 2L/3L on stable or preferred dose: Received at least 1 and no more than 2 prior systemic lines of therapy for advanced (in the unresectable locally advanced or metastatic setting) NSCLC. Patients with 2L-4L with brain metastases: Received at least 1 and no more than 3 prior systemic lines of therapy for advanced (in the unresectable locally advanced or metastatic setting) NSCLC.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior-line limits are conditional based on patient subsets (brain metastases vs. others), so they cannot be expressed as a single typed prior lines check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have asymptomatic and untreated brain metastases At least 1 untreated measurable brain lesion per mRECIST v1.1 with a long axis ≥ 0.5 cm and ≤ 3 cm.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Brain metastases subset criteria include specific mRECIST measurements and conditional line requirements that do not map to a standard typed brain_mets check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have any other documented co-existing common RAS mutation(s)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Exclusion of co-existing common RAS mutations is not a single typed variant exclusion check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Prior anti-cancer Tx within 4 weeks or drug-specific timeline within first treatment dose, whichever shorter Major surgery within 4 weeks of first treatment dose Radiation therapy (RT) within 1 week of first treatment dose
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Washout periods for prior therapies and surgery are not simple lab cutoffs.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Untreated or symptomatic CNS metastasis
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Excluding untreated or symptomatic CNS metastases conflicts with inclusion rules for certain brain metastasis subsets, making it complex.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Receipt of strong CYP3A4 inhibitor/inducer or CYP3A4 sensitive substrates with narrow therapeutic index within 14 days or drug-specific timeline within first treatment dose, whichever is shorter
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Complex drug interaction exclusions are not covered by typed checks.
